intentions.title: Give every new Barkpark user a working, deployable blog in one scaffold command — not just SDK docs
intentions.evidence: The whole app/ tree is a Next.js 15 App Router starter (layout.tsx, page.tsx, posts/[slug], tags/[slug], authors/[id]) shipped inside create-barkpark-app's templates/ dir, wired end-to-end to @barkpark/nextjs and @barkpark/react — a complete reference implementation, not a snippet.

intentions.title: Prove and demonstrate the full Barkpark content-authoring loop: draft in Studio, preview instantly, publish, and have the live site revalidate automatically
intentions.evidence: app/api/preview/route.ts enables Next draftMode() gated by BARKPARK_PREVIEW_SECRET; app/api/exit-preview/route.ts disables it; posts/[slug]/page.tsx branches to DraftModePreview when isDraft; app/api/barkpark/webhook/route.ts wires createWebhookHandler + revalidateBarkpark so Studio mutations push through to the deployed site via BARKPARK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

intentions.title: Ship a real information architecture for editorial content — posts, authors, and tags all cross-linked — as the template's worked example
intentions.evidence: posts/[slug]/page.tsx links to /authors/{id} and /tags/{slug}; authors/[id]/page.tsx and tags/[slug]/page.tsx each filter getDocs<Post>('post') by _ref to build a reverse index of posts; components/Pagination.tsx supplies page-based navigation for listing views.

intentions.title: Preview/draft access must never leak unpublished content to production visitors or anonymous crawlers
intentions.evidence: preview/route.ts: fail-closed guard — if BARKPARK_PREVIEW_SECRET is unset, draft mode only opens outside production; generateMetadata in posts/[slug]/page.tsx explicitly fetches the published doc (isDraft=false) so crawlers/OG previews never see drafts even when a visitor is in draft mode.

intentions.title: Preview and exit-preview redirects must be open-redirect-proof
intentions.evidence: Both api/preview/route.ts and api/exit-preview/route.ts validate the `path` query param must start with '/' and reject '//' and '/\\' before using it as a same-origin NextResponse.redirect target.

intentions.title: Every page in the starter is discoverable, accessible, and SEO-correct by default, not left as an exercise for the adopter
intentions.evidence: layout.tsx ships a WCAG 2.4.1 skip-link and metadataBase for absolute OG URLs; robots.ts and sitemap.ts exist alongside error.tsx/loading.tsx/not-found.tsx; generateMetadata on post/tag/author pages calls barkparkMetadata() (or hand-builds openGraph) so every content page gets correct title/description/OG tags out of the box.
